name: Ernest Lee

name: Michelle Wang
title: Assistant Professor, Bioengineering and Therapeutic Sciences
research: Michelle Wang joined the UCSF faculty in 2024 with the Department of Bioengineering and Therapeutic Sciences. She is also involved in the Master’s Program of Artificial Intelligence and Computational Drug Discovery and Development at the School of Pharmacy. Her research focuses on developing computational methods, integrating clinical pharmacology, pharmaceutical sciences, and clinical informatics, to advance data-driven therapeutic strategies.
